Building a home AI Video studio no longer takes a big crew or budget.

Ten open-source GitHub projects worth bookmarking:

2. Wan 2.2 - lifelike clips from prompts or stills
3. LTX-Video - quick open models
4. AnimateDiff - motion for still pictures

6. Open-Sora - open video generation
7. HunyuanVideo - AI-generated clips from a written brief
8. MoviePy - scripted cuts and subtitles in Python
9. Blender - 3D sets and renders
10. Nerfstudio - real places turned into 3D from your photos

Chain them and you get creative workflows end to end: make a shot, move it, cut it, place it in a 3D world.

Save this 🔖

This is a SAMPLE of top-relevance posts, not every post on X. Views = impression_count at fetch time. Rank = sum of sampled 24 h views; 48 h = both windows; trend = 24 h sum / previous 24 h sum (up >=1.3, down <=0.7). Fresh posts are still gaining views, so 'up' is understated. Top-post share > 70% means one viral post carries the keyword.
